topic: Fake unpaid toll text scam — tapping the link vs verifying (Vance vs Riley)

scenes.narration: A fake toll text drained eleven thousand dollars. Case file 0053. Open the evidence.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash in a noir office holding a magnifying glass over a phone screen showing a fake text reading UNPAID TOLL, comic banner reads ELEVEN FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Vance and Riley both get a text claiming they owe a toll.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of vance in a parking lot and riley at her desk both holding phones with the same red toll text, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The text demands six dollars and ninety five cents paid today.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, close up of a phone showing a text reading PAY SIX DOLLARS NINETY FIVE TODAY OR FACE FINE, urgent red font, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Vance taps the link and sees a real looking toll authority page.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man vance hunched over a phone showing a fake state toll authority website with official looking seals, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He types his card number, billing zip, and the back security code.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, vance typing into a checkout form with the fields CARD NUMBER, ZIP, and CVV highlighted, comic banner reads JUST SIX BUCKS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Riley closes the text and types the official site by hand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman riley at a kitchen table holding a phone with a browser address bar circled in green, manually typed URL visible, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her real account shows a balance of zero dollars owed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, riley smiling at a real toll authority account page showing BALANCE ZERO in green, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Forty minutes later Vance gets two red alerts on his phone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked vance at a parking lot looking at a phone covered in red transaction alerts, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Scammers bought three Apple gift cards and a laptop with his card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, three apple gift cards and a laptop floating on a checkout screen stamped APPROVED, comic banner reads ELEVEN FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eleven thousand four hundred dollars gone before he finished lunch.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, vance staring at a frozen card on a lunch table, a sandwich half eaten beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Riley still has her six dollars. Same scam, two outcomes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side vance with an empty wallet, right side riley with a clean bank screen and a coffee, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: States never text toll bills with links. Type the site yourself. Case closed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash holding a magnifying glass over a phone with a giant red X over a text link, comic banner reads CASE CLOSED, kids comic book illustration
